book.title: JONE Gotena Pii Layene Epene Joneto Pepa Peleane Oko

content: Lasatosa Omeane Oko
Betani tano okona tane akali Lasatosa lene mindi bala siki oma-yene yaepia. Betani tano okone bala wanda Matiya, balana akini Mata-la, okone-lapona yuu tene oko yane.

Matili Matiya okonemane wele tunduma-pene mindi Akali Andane okona kenenga gae loto, balana kawa itini-mane kunu apia-maiya. Matiya, Mata-la, okone-lapona imalini Lasatosa oko bala siki oma-yene ya-kola, balana imalini okonelapo-mane pii mindi Jisasa ateanga wai lo aimo loto, Akali Andane, akali nimba towa epelewa yamapane yo atalene pia okone bala siki oma-yene eya leapelepia.

Wuane leapele okone ale wato, Jisasato pii mindi loto, Goteto Lasatosa bala mee omeakale nembo toto, siki okone balanga epeakale lo ando konda nayane. Jia. Wandakali-mane Gote Iwanane okona gene oko laiyu leakale nembo toto, Goteto balana tai-lene oko andawa loyale, siki okone Lasatosa balanga epeakale lo ando konda yane lea.

Gotena tai-lene oko wandakali tupanga andawa lokale nembo toto, Jisasato Lasatosa siki oma-yene eya lene ale wato teke, bala wamba kapoyale andolo puu napene, ole lapoai bala yuu ateane okonena mee maliyo atea. Jisasato Mata, balana akini Matiyapi, okone-lapona imalini Lasatosapi, utupane towa epelewa yamapane yo atalaepia.
Wuaneko, ole okonelapo pea-angi, balato balana disaipolo tupa lamawuato, nanima Jutiya disitiki okona peke lamakale lea.
Wuane lea-kola, balana disaipolo tupamane bala lamawuato, tisa, Juta yame akali tupamane nimba ana-mane peyo ome loyale pipiai-ko. Nimbato yuu okonena dee lapone polape leai.

Wuane leai-kola, Jisasato utupanena pii okone yano peyoto, upa pitane nai oko epoto, tama pulu, ole-lene andaka palane lea. Nai tola-kola, wandakali mindi bala epoko pua ateando, balato asini oko kuai lo andoto, ayia peya napulu-peya.
Wandakali okone ayia peya napulu-peya tekeko, wandakali mindi bala utulu epoko pua ateando, yuu oko undupi lola-kola, balato asini kuai lo anda napene, ayia peyolo-peya lea.
Wuane lalu, balato pii mindi tako pua loto, nanima towa epelewa atalane akali Lasatosa oko bala limu palia ondo apiya-ko. Nambato bala peya ika lolo pokale lea.

Lasatosa manda tapia nembo toto, Jisasato bala limu palia ondo apiaya-ko leane tekeko, balana disaipolo tupamane Lasatosa mee limu palipia-kola, wuane leya nembo teainipia. Wuane nembo toto, utupane-mane bala lamawuato, Akali Andane, Lasatosa limu paleando, balana siki oko atu yolopeya yalua leai.
Wuane leai-kola, balato utupane panakame lamawuato, Lasatosa wamba manda tapia lea.

Yakamato namba lo bilipi leyama nayu bilipi lalapale nembo toto, namba bala towa atu ata napiwa-kola, bala wamba manda tapia. Wuane tekeko, nambato bala malinga ika laya olowa-kola, yakamato namba lo bilipi leyama nayu bilipi lolopeyai nembo toto, namba epele wete eyo. Andipa bala manda-tene eya okona nanima maa lea.
Wuane lea-kola, akali Tomasa gene mindi Ditimasa lene okomane disaipolo waka tupa lamawuato, nanima bala towa atu omolo maa lea.
Matato Nimba Gote Iwanane Atele Leane Oko

Betani tano oko Jutusaleme mandaka gulo kilomita tepopi mindi angu ya-kola, Juta yame wandakali kambua-mane Lasatosa manda tapia lene oko ale yainipia. Ale wato, utupane-mane Matiya, Mata-la, okone-lapona yamapane mo epene pale lamakale nembo toto, Jutusaleme tepa alu, okonelapo peteapi okona poto, ateainipia. Matili Jisasa bala peakaiyu lea-angi, wandakali-mane bala lamawuato, Lasatosa mali pima-kola, ole tukumindi pupia leai.
Matato Jisasa epeya lene ale wato, asininga poto, Jisasa malanda ya. Matiya bala mee andaka petea.
Matato Jisasa malanda ya-angi, bala lamawuato, Akali Andane, nimba wali atapi-yale, nambana imalini oko oma napipia-yale.
Andipapi nimbato Gote lo pote loto, balato nimba moyoyale mangene mindi peakale leendo, balato ale wato, nimbato lole pua pulupeya lo nambato nembo teyo lea.
Wuane lea-kola, Jisasato bala lamawuato, nimbana imalini oko malinga ika lolopeya lea.
Wuane lea-kola, Matato bala lamawuato, matili yuu koyo puyale pula-kola, wandakali omene tupa malinga ika lolai okone angi, nambana imalini okone bala malinga ika lolopeya nembo teyo lea.

Wuane lea-kola, Jisasato bala lamawuato, nambato wandakali omene tupa malinga ika laya wato, saka atapowa ateakale lo ataya alawane-ko. Namba lo bilipi lene wandakali mindi omoto teke, malinga ika lalu, saka atapowa atolopeya lea.
Namba lo bilipi loto, saka atapowa atolai wandakali utupane yakama katulo dee lapone oma napulu-peyai. Nimbato wuane lo bilipi lelepe lea.
Wuane lea-kola, Matato balana pii okone yano peyoto, enene, Akali Andane nimba Gote Iwanane oko atele lo bilipi leyo. Nimba Mesaya wamba Goteto yuunga epeakale lolo-peyawa leane oko atele lea.
Jisasa Bala Ai Leane Oko
Matato wuane lalu, andaka peke loto, balana akini Matiya tengamane lamawuato, tisa oko mandaka epo atoto, nimba ipu leya leaipia.
Wuane lea-kola, Matiyato pii okone ale wato, kapoyale ika lalu, Jisasa malanda olo peaipia.

Matiya bala kapoyale ika lalu, kamaka pea-kola, Juta yame wandakali bala yamapane mo epene pale lamakale loto, bala towa atu andaka peteaini tupamane bala malinga ai lolo peya nembo toto, bala watama peainipia. Jisasa bala Betani tano okona naepene, Mata asininga malanda yane ongane mee maliyo atea.
Maliyo atea-kola, Matiya epoto, Jisasa andoto, balana kee yane ongane aiki lekawa, tombawua loto, Akali Andane, nimba wali atapi-yale, nambana imalini oko oma napipia-yale lea.

Wuane lalu, Matiyato ai lo yamataka lea-kola, Juta yame wandakali bala towa atu epeaini tupamanepi ai lo yamataka teke leai. Utupane-mane ai lo yamataka leai oko andoto, Jisasato utupane ondo wato, yamapane kenda wete ya.

Yamapane kenda wete wato, bala ai lea. Ai lea-kola, Juta yame wandakali tupa yakama teke-teke pii lalawa puato, balato Lasatosa towa epelewa yamapane wete yalaeya oko andalapa leai. Utupane-mane wuane leaini tekeko, yangi-mane pii mindi loto, balato akali lee koo mindi lee taya yako. Balato Lasatosa towa epelewa yamapane wete yapia-yale, bala oma napeakale nembo toto, katulo bala moyapia-yale jiape leai. Wuane leai-kola, balato utupane tipa puato, yakamato bala aninga mali pipiaipe lea-kola, utupane-mane bala lamawuato, Akali Andane nimbato andolo ipu leai.
Jisasato Lasatosa Malinga Ika Laya Yane Oko

Nimbato andolo ipu leai-kola, Jisasa bala dee lapone yamapane kenda wete wato, Lasatosa mali pitane yanenga pea. Wamba Lasatosa yame tupamane bala ana anda mindina mali puato, ana andane mindimane mali okona asia tuma peainipia.

Mali okona asia oko ana andane mindimane tuma pitane atea-kola, Jisasato akali minditupa lamawuato, yakamato ana oko minu pendeke lo apialapa lea. Wuane lea-kola, akali omeane okona imalini Matato Jisasa lamawuato, Akali Andane, nambana imalini oko mali pitane atapia-kola, ole tukumindi pupia-ko. Andipa bala tamuto, guu koo pulupeya lea.
Wuane lea-kola, Jisasato bala lamawuato, nimbato namba lo bilipi leendo, Gotena tai-lene andane oko andolopele lo nambato nimba wamba langiyo okoni lea.

Wuane lea-kola, utupane-mane ana okone minu pendeke lo apeai. Apeai-kola, Jisasa bala ati kenga andaiyu loto, nambato loma eyo-kola, Ayiane Gote nimbato ale alene okonena, nambato nimba wayu pele leyo lea.

Ole dindi lo nambato loma eyo-kola, nimbato ale alene lo nambato nembo teyo tekeko, wandakali onga ateyai tupamane mangene mindi nambato puluwa okone andoto, nimbato namba ati kenga atala yuunga puu lee-kola, namba epea ya lo bilipi leakale nembo toto, nambato loma oko eyo lea.
Wuane lalu, Jisasato pii taimane loto, Lasatosa, nimba takita ipu lea.

Takita ipu lea-kola, wamba manda teane akali Lasatosa bala saka atolo-peke lalu, mali okona takita epea. Wamba bala manda tea-angi, wandakali tupamane bala mali puyale, balana kinipi, kenepi, kawanepi, utupane lapa-lapa minditupa-mane ombo wato, tongo peainipia. Bala malinga ika lea-angi, Jisasato wandakali tupa lamawuato, bala katulo epoko peakalenga, yakamato lapa-lapa tupa tita lo tepa alapa lea.
Jisasa Peyo Ome Lamakale Leaini Oko
Jisasato Lasatosa malinga ika laya yane okone angi, Matiya towa atu Juta yame wandakali epeaini utupanena kambua-mane metekolo piape Jisasato peane okone andoto, bala lo bilipi leai.
Wuane tekeko, wandakali utupanena minditupa-mane Patasai tupa ateainga poto, wamba Jisasato metekolo minditupa piyu, andipa Lasatosa malinga ika laya ala lo lamai-yainipia.

Lamai-yaikola, Patasai tupapi, pitisa akali kawane tupapi, utupane-mane akali kanjole tupa epeakale lo mo amunguli puato, akali okonemane metekolo piape kambua piyane leainipia. Balato metekolo piape kambua pua ateakale loto, nanimato ando kondemando, wandakali tupa pitaka-mane bala lo bilipi lolai-kola, Lomo tane gapomane ami tupa epoto, Juta yame wandakali nanima minu koyalu, nanimana lotu anda andane oko keao lo apolopeyai. Wuane pulaini nembo toto, nanimato anu piamape leainipia.

Akali utupanena mindi gene Kayapasa lene okone bala ee ana okonena pitisa akali kawane oko ateaipia. Balato akali waka utupane lamawuato, kenda-pene nanimanga eya oko mo tika pulane asini oko yakamato aŋakopi mindi nembo nateyai lea.

Lomo tane ami tupa epoto, nanima minu koyaindo, Juta yame wandakali nanima pitaka alu pulumane. Akali mindiki-mane nanimana panda moto omeando, bala omola okonemane nanima moyolo-peya lo yakamato nembo nateyaipe leaipia.

Pii leane okone Kayapasa bala tane angu nembo toto naleaipia. Jia. Ee ana okonena bala pitisa akali kawane atoto, potopisa pii mindi loto, Jisasato Juta yame wandakali tupa moyoyale omolo-peya leaipia.

Jisasato Juta yame wandakali tupa angu moyoyale omolo-peya naleaipia. Jia. Jisasato Gotena andopane yuu waka-waka tupa puu toko lene tupa mo amunguli puato, yame mindiki gulaya oyale, bala omolo-peya loto, pitisa akali kawane okonemane pii okone leaipia.
Kayapasato pii okone lea-kola, ole okone angi ato tewa, Patasai tupapi, pitisa akali kawane tupapi, utupane-mane Jisasa peyo ome lamakale loto, pii mindi lo puta peainipia.

Utupane-mane pii okone lo puta peai-kola, okone angi tewa, Jisasa bala Juta yame wandakali tupana tombenenga panakame epoko pua ata napea. Jia. Balana disaipolo tupa towa atu bala Betani tano oko tepa alu, tano Epotame lene okona poto ateai. Tano okone wandakali napalene yuu yane mindina mandaka ongane ya.

Okone angi, Juta yame wandakali tupamane Pasopa tomo nalaini oto oko mandaka gulea-kola, wandakali kambua-mane Gotena wenonga yakamanga koo tene mindi nayapia lakae lo nembo toto, wamba ini Jutusaleme peainipia.

Wandakali utupane lotu anda andane okona banisa anda-pangosa kolandaka loto, Jisasa ayia pua ateai-kola, pitisa akali kawane tupapi, Patasai tupapi, utupane-mane wandakali utupane lamawuato, nanimato Jisasa andi lamakale-ko. Mindimane bala mindinga ateya nembo teaindo, nanima langi-yapape leainipia. Wuane leai-kola, wandakali utupane yakama teke-teke pii lalawa puato, Juta yamena akali kawane tupamane bala peyo ome lolane lo yuku wato, Jisasa bala Pasopa tomo oko nolo naepolo-peya. Jia wete. Nanimato wuane nembo teyama. Yakamato aki nembo teyaipe leainipia.
